name: cap_film
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 (power-electronics expansion): snubbers, DC-link, resonant tanks. Buckets: 'Film Capacitors' (~1.6k) + 'Polypropylene Film Capacitors (CBB)' (~2.3k). MOSTLY THROUGH-HOLE ('Plugin,P=7.5mm' packages) — the smd flag marks the exceptions; expect smd=0/NULL to dominate. Safety-rated X/Y caps are NOT here — see cap_safety.
columns: polypropylene is the one for high-dV/dt snubber/resonant duty; filter with
--where "dielectric ~ polyprop" (the CBB bucket is polypropylene by name
even when this attr is absent).
